examples.arabic: مفيش دروس خصوصيه يوم السبت عشان كده نقدر نروح
examples.english: There are no private lessons on Saturday so we can go
examples.transliteration: mafish doroos khosooseyya yom el sabt ashan keda nedar nerooh

examples.arabic: في المدرسة بياخد دروس وبيشوف اصحابه
examples.english: At school, he takes lessons and sees his friends.
examples.transliteration: Fil-madrasa biyakhud duruus w biyishuf ashabu.
